value.answer: I'm sorry you're looking for someone to talk to, that's a good step. If it ever feels urgent, go to the nearest emergency department or call emergency services. For free help, Ontario Structured Psychotherapy gives free, publicly funded CBT to adults in Ontario with depression or anxiety-related concerns. You don't need an Ontario health card or a family doctor, and you can refer yourself. It's offered virtually, by phone or in person. Find your local network through Ontario Health's OSP page and fill in the referral form. I couldn't tell which network covers your part of Toronto, and OSP isn't a fit for everyone with complex needs. If you'd rather pay privately, Affordable Therapy Services lists online sessions from $50 on a sliding scale, though prices may have changed.
